dunes-script-module.name: RestClient
dunes-script-module.description:
Returns the RestClient constructor, a generic client for REST endpoints built on the vRO REST plugin.
Usage (create and use the client inside ONE scriptable task or action): var RestClient = System.getModule("com.evoila.rest").RestClient(); var client = new RestClient({ baseUrl: "https://api.example.local", // or host: <REST:RESTHost> auth: { type: "bearer", token: token } // or { type: "basic", username: u, password: p } }); var item = client.getJson("/v1/things/42"); var all = client.getAllPages("/v1/things", { query: { state: "ok" } }, RestClient.pagers.pageNumber({ itemsField: "content", pageSize: 100 }));
Options: host | baseUrl (exactly one), auth, defaultHeaders, throwOnError (default true), retry {maxAttempts, baseDelayMs, maxDelayMs, retryNonIdempotent}, debug. URL mode only: connectionTimeoutSec, operationTimeoutSec, hostVerification (default true), trustCert (default false; imports the server CA into the Orchestrator keystore, a write to the keystore).
Auth: "bearer" adds an Authorization header per request (both modes). "basic" is set on the transient host (URL mode only; a REST:RESTHost keeps its own authentication). "none" uses whatever the host has configured. Per-call option pathEncoded: true skips encoding of the path (absolute next-page URLs are never re-encoded).
Methods: request, get, post, put, patch, del, getJson, postJson, putJson, patchJson, deleteJson, getAllPages. request() returns {statusCode, headers (lower-case keys), body, ok, json()}. A non-2xx response throws an Error with statusCode and responseBody properties unless throwOnError is false. 429 and 5xx (and connection errors) are retried; POST/PATCH only when retry.retryNonIdempotent is true.
Do NOT store the client in a workflow attribute or pass it between workflow items: the serialized object loses its methods. Pass the host/URL and credentials instead. Headers, tokens and passwords are never logged.
NOTE: the REST plugin calls follow the usage in the maintained pscoe tswl.http library (createHostSupportingParallelRequests, createTransientHostFrom, reloadConfiguration, RESTAuthenticationManager.createAuthentication, createRequest, setHeader, execute, statusCode, contentAsString, getAllHeaders, and the url/name/hostVerification/timeout host properties). They have not been run on a live Orchestrator yet.
